# AnonymousGCA - Official

> Personal website of AnonymousGCA (Gabriele Caretti), a full-stack and mobile developer, SvelteKit enthusiast and BSc graduate in Computer Science based in Italy. Showcases the portfolio, selected projects, contact channels and public utilities.

## Pages

- [Home](https://anonymousgca.eu/): Introduction to AnonymousGCA: BSc graduate in Computer Science with experience on web and mobile development, Full-Stack. Lists skills, contact channels and socials (GitHub, YouTube, Reddit, Discord, Crypto/Web3 profile).
- [Projects](https://anonymousgca.eu/projects): Live websites, Svelte packages and components, university work and developer tooling, open and sorted by most recent activity. Category filters, tech tags, grades, npm packages and a live preview for the websites.
- [Contacts](https://anonymousgca.eu/contacts): Direct ways to reach AnonymousGCA: email, LinkedIn, GitHub, Discord, YouTube, Reddit, Web3 profile.
- [Collection](https://anonymousgca.eu/collection): Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and Orange Pi Zero 2W single-board computer homelab: specs, usage, swap problems and lessons learned.
- [Simulatore Università](https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/universita): Italian university grade simulator based on Università degli Studi dell'Insubria (DiSTA): weighted average, CFU progress, lode bonus and final degree grade projection. Client-side only, no data saved.
- [ADE - Calcolatore Bit](https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/ade): Bit, memory and cache calculators for the computer architecture course (Architettura degli Elaboratori, Insubria): powers of two, bit to byte conversion, total memory, block size and cache sizing, plus binary and decimal converters.
- [Energia - Prezzi elettricità Italia](https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/energy): Hourly day-ahead electricity prices for Italy through the Mercato del Giorno Prima (MGP), bidding zone Nord as an honest PUN proxy: 3-day view with day tabs, 7 and 30 day trends, 12 months of history, cheapest 3-hour slot, stats, tables and a cost estimator. Data fetched client-side from energy-charts.info, official source GME.
- [Neon Grove (Pixel RPG)](https://anonymousgca.eu/utility/game): Free browser pixel RPG by AnonymousGCA. Wander the grove, haggle in the marsh and face the Null King in the Core across three levels; collect the Source Shards, level up, spend stardust at Marrow's shop and keep an autosaved progress in the browser.
- [Insubria](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria): Public transport commutes from Intra/Laveno to the Insubria campus in Varese: ferry, train and bus schedules.
  - [Lunedì](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/lunedi): Monday commute schedule: ferry (Intra-Laveno), train (Laveno-Varese Nord) and bus to campus with alternative timings.
  - [Martedì](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/martedi): Tuesday commute schedule: ferry, train and bus times from Laveno to Varese.
  - [Mercoledì](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/mercoledi): Wednesday commute schedule: ferry, train and bus times from Laveno to Varese.
  - [Giovedì](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/giovedi): Thursday commute schedule: ferry, train and bus times from Laveno to Varese.
  - [Venerdì](https://anonymousgca.eu/insubria/venerdi): Friday commute schedule: ferry, train and bus times from Laveno to Varese.

## Notes

- Every page is fully prerendered static HTML (SvelteKit + adapter-static on Bun): content is available to crawlers without JavaScript.
- The site explicitly allows AI crawlers (see robots.txt): content may be indexed and used to answer questions about AnonymousGCA.
- The utilities are client-side and privacy-friendly: the grade simulator and the game keep data on the device only (localStorage), and the energy page fetches its data from the browser (baked same-origin history plus live refreshes).
- Primary audience: recruiters and employers evaluating Gabriele Caretti as a web developer; secondary: fellow developers and university students using the utilities.
